title: extcap: Don't return the configuration in a GList with one GList member
description:
cb_preference is only called with a callback_info_t with a data parameter
when extcap_run_one is called. There's no circumstance where we want to
call every extcap binary that has the same interface name (even if we
allowed different binaries to have the same interface names) and disambiguate
them later. It doesn't make sense to append the GList of extcap_args to
another GList that will only ever have one entry. It just adds complexity.

When extcap_load_interface_list retrieves all the interfaces, it calls
cb_preference manually with a NULL data. Even if we did want to store
the returned configuration there, it would make more sense to manually
retrieve the GList of extcap_args and then store it in a GHashTable or
similar keyed by the interface or bookmark name.

commits_data.title: extcap: Don't return the configuration in a GList with one GList member
commits_data.message:
extcap: Don't return the configuration in a GList with one GList member

cb_preference is only called with a callback_info_t with a data parameter
when extcap_run_one is called. There's no circumstance where we want to
call every extcap binary that has the same interface name (even if we
allowed different binaries to have the same interface names) and disambiguate
them later. Even if we allowed that, the GList of GList of extcap_arg doesn't
contain the proper information to differentiate by the binary path. It doesn't
make sense to append the GList of extcap_args to another GList that will only
ever have one entry. It just adds complexity.

The callers of extcap_get_if_configuration() and
extcap_get_if_configuration_option() expect a configuration applying to
only a single extcap binary, not multiple extcap binaries.

When extcap_load_interface_list retrieves all the interfaces, it calls
cb_preference manually with a NULL data. Even if we did want to store
the returned configuration there, it would make more sense to manually
retrieve the GList of extcap_args and then store it in a GHashTable or
similar keyed by the interface or bookmark name.
